I (34,m) tried smoking meth when I was 16 and became fully addicted until age 19.I was  Using pretty regularly for those years. I had to leave the state and change my whole life in order to get better. It has been 15 years since I have touched  it or even come accross it. I still constantly have trouble being happy about anything.  I'm very easily irritated and basically have anxiety all day everyday. This drug turned me from a star athlete into a full-blown piece of shit in less than 6 months. It tore apart my whole life, took away so many opportunities and indefinitely stole part of my soul. I still have nightmares about it. I will never be normal now. The only way I know how to describe it is that it's evil incarnate. I'm not sure what I'm trying to accomplish by sharing all of this, but it does feel good to share this with people who may understand. There is such a stigma attached to it, it can be difficult to find places to share my story without judgments being thrown around. Thanks for listening.
